introduction: Washington weatherization provides assessed home-efficiency work through local agencies. Commerce lists providers by county.
description: Washington weatherization provides assessed home-efficiency work through local agencies. Commerce lists providers by county.

sections.who: Low-income homeowners and renters may qualify under federal-poverty, state-median or area-median income routes. The provider determines eligibility.
sections.get: An energy audit identifies suitable improvements such as insulation, air sealing or ventilation. Specific upgrades are not guaranteed.
sections.docs:
• Ask the agency for income and household records.
  • Property details and rental-owner permissions when requested.
sections.apply:
1. Find intake

    Use the county list on Commerce weatherization.

  2. Apply locally

    Confirm documentation, eligibility and waiting times.

  3. Arrange assessment

    Provide access for the energy audit and discuss property concerns.
sections.after: Agree the approved work with the provider. Weatherization is not a guaranteed emergency heating response.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Commerce weatherization. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
